description: Use this when the user wants a word search puzzle (word find, word search maker, printable word search for kids or a class) from a list of words. Accepts 5-40 words for a letter grid: right and down for easy, adding diagonals for medium, all 8 directions including backwards for hard; checks placed words for duplicate occurrences and reports words left out. Shows a playable puzzle and returns a printable PDF with an answer key. Not for crosswords (use generate_crossword) and does not find words in a grid the user already has.

difficulty.description: easy = words run right and down; medium (default) = adds diagonals; hard = all 8 directions including backwards. Example: easy

paper.description: Paper size for the printable PDF: letter (US, default) or a4. Example: a4

seed.description: Optional layout seed (1-999999). The same inputs and seed always give the same puzzle; pass a different seed for a new layout. Example: 2024

size.description: Grid width and height in letters (8-25). Leave out to size the grid automatically from the words. Example: 15

title.description: Title printed on the puzzle and PDF. Example: "Ocean Animals Word Search"

words.description: 5 to 40 words to hide. Accents, spaces and punctuation are removed ("sea horse" -> SEAHORSE). Example: ["dolphin","octopus","shark","coral","whale"]

name: generate_word_search
title: Create word search
